_about: TRANSLATOR SHELF: Willa Muir (1890-1970) and Edwin Muir (1887-1959), translating together: Lion Feuchtwanger's Power (Jew Süss; Viking, New York, 1926, a 1928 printing), The Ugly Duchess (Viking, 1928), with Success (Secker, 1930) waiting on the 1930 ruling. Printings before 1931 only. US public domain (published before 1931). Added 2026-10-23 by lane C (round 125); Adam may veto. No uids minted.
_surname_note: Full names only; bare 'muir' is a common surname and is claimed by the jessie-muir and alexander-muir shelves.
